senses.gloss:
लीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
 1. Embraced, clung or adhered to.
 2. Melted, dis-
solved.
 3. Dissolved with softness, overcome with passion.
 4. Dif-
fused.
 5. Effaced, wiped away, vanished.
 6. Staying, being situated.
7. Left, departed.
 8. Lurking, hiding.
 9. Resting on.
 10. Absorped,
swallowed up.
 11. Devoted to.
 E. ली to be in contact, &c., क्त aff.
